title: Karla Turner's husband abducted by the military

tellings.quote: Turner's husband was abducted by elements of the military

plain: The husband of Karla Turner, a writer who researched alien abductions, was "abducted by elements of the military," according to the filmmaker Tim Alberino. He tells Michels this in passing, without saying where he learned it. If true, it would mean some abductions blamed on aliens involve human soldiers.
